title: さかなのぬりえ
subject_en: Coloring pages of fish and sea creatures, each ONE big simple animal, centred, drawn with thick clean closed black outlines only and NOTHING filled in: the inside of every shape stays plain white. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 金魚、クジラ、サメ、タコなど、さかな・海の生きものの塗り絵12点。線は太くはっきりしていて、印刷して子どもと楽しめます。
items: a sea turtle with a patterned shell
a clownfish with stripes by an anemone
a tuna fish with a streamlined body
